scripts.api:lint: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev python -m ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.api:format: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev python -m ruff format apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.api:format:check: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev python -m ruff format --check apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.api:test: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev python -m pytest -q -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests
scripts.lint:ci: pnpm web:lint && pnpm api:lint && pnpm api:format:check
scripts.test:full: pnpm web:test && pnpm web:e2e && pnpm api:test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm lint:ci && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
